title: Pure Vendread
summary: Pure Vendread Zombie Ritual strategy, commanding an unrelenting bio-horror horde that revives from the graveyard to serve as Ritual Tributes. Tributing lower-Level Vendread monsters from the field bequeaths game-breaking Quick Effect banishments and targeted protections to the summoned Ritual bosses.

summary.title: Starters
points: Vendread Nights discards 1 card to search any Vendread monster from your Deck, and sends a Vendread monster from Deck to GY when your monster destroys an opponent's monster by battle.
Vendread Charge sends a Zombie monster from your hand or face-up field to the GY to Special Summon any Vendread monster directly from your Deck.
Scar of the Vendread searches a Vendread Spell or Trap from your Deck whenever it is sent to the GY, and revives itself from the GY when a monster on the field is Tributed.
Vendread Houndhorde discards a Vendread card to revive itself from the GY, granting the Ritual Monster summoned using it the Quick Effect to banish an opponent's Spell or Trap.
Vendread Striges reveals a Vendread card in hand to revive itself from the GY, granting the Ritual Monster the effect to draw 1 card and discard 1 card after battling.

summary.title: Opening: Ravenous Vendread + Slayer
steps: Activate Vendread Nights, discarding Vendread Houndhorde to search Revendread Slayer from your Deck.
Activate Ravenous Vendread, revealing Slayer to Special Summon Vendread Revenants face-down from your Deck, then Ritual Summon Revendread Slayer from your hand tributing Revenants.
Revendread Slayer inherits Revenants' effect: once per turn as a Quick Effect, target and banish 1 Special Summoned monster the opponent controls.
Discard a Vendread card to revive Vendread Houndhorde from the GY.
Link Summon Avendread Savior using Slayer and Houndhorde; Slayer triggers in GY to add Revendread Origin from Deck to hand and mill a Vendread monster.

summary.title: Ritual Heritage & Inherited Abilities
points: Ritual Monsters Tributed with monsters on the field gain their printed inherited effects.
Vendread Revenants grants a Quick Effect to target and banish 1 Special Summoned monster the opponent controls.
Vendread Houndhorde grants a Quick Effect to target and banish 1 Spell or Trap Card the opponent controls.
Vendread Core grants complete immunity to targeting from the opponent's card effects.
Vendread Anima grants the ability to banish any monster destroyed by battle with that Ritual Monster.

summary.title: Bosses & Spells
points: Revendread Slayer gains 300 ATK when battling and searches a Ritual Spell and mills a Vendread monster when sent to the GY.

Vendread Battlelord banishes a Vendread card from GY to declare a card type (Monster, Spell, or Trap), completely shutting down the opponent from activating cards or effects of that type for the rest of the turn.
Revendread Executor shields all other cards you control from being targeted by opponent card effects while on the field, and searches a Vendread card when destroyed.
Vendread Scavenger tributes another Zombie monster to gain its ATK and revives itself from GY when Revendread Slayer is on the field.
Avendread Savior is a Link-2 monster that sends a Zombie from Deck to GY during damage calculation to reduce the battling monster's ATK, and recycles a Vendread card when destroyed.
Revendread Origin and Revendread Evolution Ritual Summon Vendread monsters using materials from hand, field, GY, or even sending directly from the Deck.
